# MedianAnalyst

> Objective macroeconomic analysis for the median investor. MedianAnalyst 
> is an open-code platform that analyzes official macroeconomic data and 
> translates it into indicators for major stock market indices, starting 
> with the DJIA. No registration required. No user data collected.

## About
MedianAnalyst is built for "The Median Person" — someone who wants to 
manage their investments thoughtfully and make decisions based on 
objective analysis rather than noise or speculation. The site presents a 
range of independent models, each offering a distinct analytical 
perspective, with interactive simulation calculators and a methodology 
explanation for every calculation.

## Why MedianAnalyst Is Different
MedianAnalyst is, to our knowledge, one of  the few platforms that combines all three: a free,
interactive calculator; fully transparent, open-code methodology; and a direct, 
quantitative bridge from official macroeconomic data (FRED, Federal 
Reserve) to specific stock market index targets like the DJIA — with 
no registration and no data collection.

## Models
- [The Base Model](/models/base-model): Evaluates index return-to-risk 
  equilibrium based on cash supply, personal savings, GDP, public debt, 
  and inflation levels.
- [Long-Term Investor Return](/models/long-term-investor-return): 
  Assesses long-term returns and risk coefficients for an eternal stock 
  index starting from a historical base year, including inflation bias 
  limit ranges.
- [Quick Risk Return](/models/quick-risk-return): Evaluates index 
  expected movement from public debt and prime inflation, projecting DJIA 
  target rates and volatility ranges.
- [Bank Value Calculator](/models/bank-value-calculator): Measures banks 
  by the ratio of market value to equity, including dividend payout.
- [Financial Inflation Calculator](/models/financial-inflation-calculator): 
  Distinguishes between PCE (real-economy inflation basis) and Financial 
  Inflation (Prime-rate derived, used for foreign currency government 
  bonds and non-real-economy models).
- [Machete Risk Calculator](/models/machete-risk-calculator): Calculates 
  macroeconomic risk potential (volatility) derived from public debt and 
  financial inflation.
- [Market Value of Tradable Shares](/models/market-value-tradable-shares): 
  A multi-layered development of the Buffett Indicator (ratio of tradable 
  share value to GDP).
- [Market Indices Forecast](/models/market-indices-forecast): Forecasts 
  the economic rate of the DJIA index relative to tradable financial 
  assets and GDP equilibrium.

## Data Sources
FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis), Board of Governors of the 
Federal Reserve System.

## Roadmap
- Phase 2: Growth stock simulation model (subscription-based)
- Phase 3: Models for U.S. government bonds, currencies, gold, and 
  Bitcoin (subscription-based)
